name: Post-Matric Scholarship — SC / ST / SCC Students (Tamil Nadu)
provider: Adi Dravidar & Tribal Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Tamil Nadu's post-matric scholarship for Adi Dravidar (SC), Tribal and Converted Christian (SCC) students covering maintenance allowance and special fees from +1 to research.

benefit.amount_display: ₹6,000 – ₹12,000 / year + special fee & exam fee coverage
benefit.details: Course-group-wise maintenance plus special/exam fee reimbursement; SCC students also covered.

special_conditions: SCC (SC-converted Christian) students apply under the same line

steps: Apply through the institution's scholarship nodal officer

name: BC / MBC / DNC Post-Matric Scholarship (Tamil Nadu)
provider: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes & Minorities Welfare Dept., Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Post-matric scholarship and fee support for Backward Class, Most Backward Class and Denotified Community students of Tamil Nadu.

benefit.details: Maintenance + special fee components; government hostel students get board support in addition.

special_conditions: BC/MBC/DNC community certificate of Tamil Nadu
Income ceiling notified per department — verify current G.O.

notes: Income ceiling varies by G.O. — flagged for re-verification.

name: First Graduate Tuition Fee Concession (Tamil Nadu)
provider: Directorate of Technical Education / Higher Education Dept., Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Full tuition-fee concession for students who are the first graduate of their family, admitted to professional/arts & science courses in Tamil Nadu through counselling.

benefit.amount_display: Tuition fee fully waived (govt quota seats)
benefit.details: Tuition fee borne by the government for first-graduate students in counselling-admitted seats.

special_conditions: No graduate in the student's family (father/mother/siblings) — First Graduate certificate from the Tahsildar
One family-member limit: the concession can be claimed for only one son or one daughter; revised guidelines allow re-verified second-child claims in some cycles

steps: Obtain the First Graduate certificate from the e-Sevai/Tahsildar office
College applies the waiver at admission

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
provider: Department of Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: ₹1,000/month paid to girls who studied Class VI–XII in Tamil Nadu government schools and go on to higher education — designed to keep girls in college instead of early marriage.

benefit.details: Monthly DBT through the entire UG/diploma programme for eligible government-school girls.

special_conditions: Girl studied Class VI to XII in a Tamil Nadu government school (EMIS-verified)
Enrolled in a recognised UG/diploma/professional course
Continues while attending college; stops on drop-out/marriage as per guidelines
Students receiving other government scholarships may still be eligible — verify current clarification

documents: EMIS-linked school records (Class VI–XII govt school)
Aadhaar + bank account of the student

steps: College registers/verifies the student on the portal

name: Tamil Nadu Farmers' Welfare Scholarship (Uzhavar Nal Variyam)
provider: Tamil Nadu Farmers' Welfare Board / Agriculture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Scholarship and book/instrument allowances for children of registered farmers' welfare board members studying higher-education courses.

benefit.details: Annual scholarship varies by course (UG/PG/professional) with girls rated higher; separate book allowances.

special_conditions: Parent must be a registered member of the Tamil Nadu Farmers' Welfare Board

documents: Parent's Uzhavar welfare board membership proof

steps: Collect the form at the district/collector office or welfare board

notes: Board schemes revise rates periodically — flagged for re-verification.
